native_runtime.environment: Non-elevated Windows ConPTY, zero-player private server, two distinct managed processes with DLL hashes matching build 26920110.
native_runtime.readback: Both active campaign files were captured before the first normal stop. The fixture put shutdown files and rotated backups aside and restored the two captured SHA-256 values. A fresh process selected the sole full path in the native load menu, loaded the existing campaign and started a round. Readback preceded endgame and any second manual save. The server then returned to the lobby.
